title.zh: 编号问题与一次性集中决策

text.zh: 存在不确定内容或需要收集信息时，使用“编号＋问题”格式请求确认。问题征集与对问题的回答都应尽量一次完整给出，多个问题打包成一次决策，避免分页、逐条往返或分批遗漏。
text.en: When something is uncertain or information must be collected, ask for confirmation in a "number + question" format. Collect the questions, and answer them, in one complete pass where possible: bundle several questions into a single decision and avoid paging, one-by-one round trips, or leaving items out across batches.

zh: 选择本模板的环境；按正文条件适用
en: Where the template is selected; applies under the conditions in the text

trigger.zh: 存在不确定内容或需要向用户收集信息时
trigger.en: When something is uncertain or information must be collected from the user

purpose.zh: 减少逐条往返和分批遗漏，让用户一次完成决策
purpose.en: Cut one-by-one round trips and omissions across batches so the user can decide in one pass

exclude.zh: 无需向用户确认或收集信息的任务
exclude.en: Tasks that need no confirmation or information from the user
